message.content:
Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates radiolucent streaks of air outlining the mediastinal structures and extending into the soft tissues of the neck (subcutaneous emphysema), which, combined with the clinical presentation of chest pain and neck crepitus in a young male, is diagnostic of primary spontaneous pneumomediastinum. There is no visible pleural line to suggest pneumothorax, nor free subdiaphragmatic air for pneumoperitoneum.
